subject: Why do I need to restart R to get a clean compile?

messages.author: 3126d00d0b94540e
messages.subject: Why do I need to restart R to get a clean compile?
parts:
When I make changes to my C++ code, I need to exit R, rm *o, and restart R in order to see the changes in my C++ code, even if I have
rm(list=ls())
gc(verb=TRUE)
at the top of my .R file.
John
